name: Transfers to many newly created crypto addresses
description: Repeated small or fixed-amount transfers to many fresh or new crypto addresses.
fp: Privacy-conscious users and wallet software that rotates addresses can produce this pattern.

sources.text: FATF, Virtual Assets: Red Flag Indicators of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (2020)
FATF, Updated Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Virtual Assets and Virtual Asset Service Providers (2021)
FinCEN, Advisory on Illicit Activity Involving Convertible Virtual Currency (FIN-2019-A003, 2019)

FinCEN, Proposal of Special Measure Regarding Convertible Virtual Currency Mixing as a Class of Transactions of Primary Money Laundering Concern, Notice of Proposed Rulemaking, 88 FR 72701 (23 Oct 2023)
FATF, Targeted Update on Implementation of the FATF Standards on Virtual Assets and VASPs (annual since 2019)

links.name: Withdrawals to many fresh addresses in fixed amounts
links.ctx: Balances are split into many near-identical outputs sent to newly created wallets (peeling or splitting pattern).

links.name: Retail users with repeated small transfers to many new addresses
links.ctx: Frequent low-value outbound transfers to different external wallets after small incoming crowd-sourced payments.
links.fp: Tipping, gaming and DeFi use produce similar patterns.
